At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in an exact 90-degree side profile, her shoulders, hips, knees, and feet aligned perpendicular to the camera while her face remains in profile. Frame her from head to mid-calf with a level side-on camera placed at hip height. The smooth opaque swimsuit follows a gently rounded forward lower-pelvic front contour, making the lower-pelvic front contour visibly pronounced in silhouette while the fabric surface remains continuous and fully covering. Her posture is relaxed and self-possessed, with one foot slightly ahead for balance. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, waist, and lower-pelvic side contour; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: An exact side-on body orientation, with the principal body planes perpendicular to the camera rather than a three-quarter view.
